canonical_definition: TR_close[t] / TR_close[t-255] - 1
formation_refresh_holding: 255 sessions; refresh weekly or monthly; hold to next rebalance
pit_rule: all 256 observations available by signal close
long_only_evidence: direct project evidence exists
project_translation: existing definition is retained as control
notes: Not a literal parameter from LIT001; this is the project's frozen baseline.

canonical_definition: TR_close[t-21] / TR_close[t-252] - 1
high_score_means: stronger intermediate trend excluding recent month
formation_refresh_holding: 252 sessions with 21-session skip; monthly refresh; one-month project holding
pit_rule: both endpoints known at signal close
long_only_evidence: paper evidence mostly portfolio spread
project_translation: keep one canonical 12-1 path
notes: Treat weekly execution as a separate future path.

canonical_definition: TR_close[t-126] / TR_close[t-252] - 1
formation_refresh_holding: 252 sessions with recent 126 sessions excluded; monthly refresh and holding
pit_rule: both endpoints known at signal close
long_only_evidence: positive evidence includes large liquid stocks
project_translation: use one 12-to-7 definition rather than a grid
notes: Mechanistically different from merely changing 255 to 189 sessions.

canonical_definition: split_adjusted_close[t] / max(split_adjusted_close[t-251:t])
high_score_means: price is closer to its prior-year high
formation_refresh_holding: 252 sessions; monthly refresh; original holding six months
pit_rule: price basis and split handling fixed before signal close
long_only_evidence: paper reports monotone long-leg behavior
project_translation: do not silently substitute total-return price
notes: Dividends can move total-return price without changing the price anchor in the original mechanism.

canonical_definition: sum of monthly residuals from t-12 through t-2 divided by residual volatility; residuals come from a rolling 36-month FF3 regression
high_score_means: stronger stock-specific trend after common-factor removal
formation_refresh_holding: 36-month estimation; 12-1 formation; monthly refresh and holding
pit_rule: factor returns and stock returns available by month-end; no future regression rows
long_only_evidence: large-stock robustness reported
project_translation: a SPY-only residual version would need a new factor ID
notes: Designed to reduce market value and size-factor contamination.

canonical_definition: PRET is 12-1 cumulative return; ID = sign(PRET) * (fraction_negative_days - fraction_positive_days); prefer high PRET then low ID
high_score_means: positive return accumulated through many small consistent moves
formation_refresh_holding: 252 sessions with 21-session skip; monthly double sort; medium holding
pit_rule: all daily signs and PRET known at signal close
long_only_evidence: paper long leg is conditional on momentum
project_translation: implement lexicographic or documented double sort rather than arbitrary weighted sum
notes: Low ID alone also describes persistent losers and is not a standalone buy signal.

canonical_definition: -(TR_close[t] / TR_close[t-21] - 1)
high_score_means: larger prior-month loss and stronger reversal candidate
formation_refresh_holding: 21 sessions; monthly refresh; one-month holding
pit_rule: both endpoints known at signal close
long_only_evidence: long-leg evidence exists but costs matter
project_translation: keep 21 sessions as primary; five-day reversal is a separate later path
notes: Likely negatively correlated with long momentum and sensitive to execution costs.

canonical_definition: mean of stock return relative to the market in the same calendar month at lags 12 24 36 48 and 60 months; require at least three observations
high_score_means: stronger historical performance in the coming calendar month
formation_refresh_holding: up to five annual lags; monthly refresh and one-month holding
pit_rule: only completed historical same-month returns may enter
long_only_evidence: long leg reported but original history extends farther
project_translation: five-year version is forced by 2013 data start and must not be called a 20-year replication
notes: The 2018 start has only five annual lags at best.

canonical_definition: value-weighted total return of the stock's PIT industry over the prior six months
formation_refresh_holding: six calendar months; monthly refresh; original holding six months
required_inputs: historical industry classification|PIT market cap|stock returns
pit_rule: industry membership and weights effective at each historical date
long_only_evidence: direct Top-K long leg may be industry concentrated
project_translation: use as model feature or combined with stock signal before standalone Top-K
notes: Only about 20 distinct values in the original construction.

canonical_definition: sum of stock return minus market return from trading day -1 through +2 around the latest released quarterly earnings announcement
high_score_means: more positive price response to released earnings news
formation_refresh_holding: latest completed event window; monthly refresh; one to twelve-month diagnostics
required_inputs: PIT earnings announcement timestamp|daily returns|market return
pit_rule: event may enter only after the +2 close is known
long_only_evidence: positive drift evidence after good news
project_translation: do not use actual announcement return before the event window closes
notes: This is price-based event information but still needs a PIT event calendar.

canonical_definition: indicator that the firm is expected to announce annual earnings in the coming month based on its prior-year announcement month
formation_refresh_holding: form at prior month-end; hold expected announcement month
pit_rule: expectation must be formed from previously observed schedules rather than actual future date
long_only_evidence: announcer long leg is directly studied
project_translation: a quarterly calendar adaptation requires a new ID
notes: This isolates known event timing without using the future earnings number.

canonical_definition: EWMA of close-to-open returns minus EWMA of open-to-close returns using the paper's decay and recent-month exclusion
high_score_means: overnight-dominant rather than intraday-dominant historical performance
formation_refresh_holding: paper EWMA horizon; monthly refresh and next-month component analysis
pit_rule: overnight returns must bridge splits dividends and ticker events without lookahead
long_only_evidence: total close-to-close long-leg direction is not established
project_translation: resolve appendix decay exactly before assigning an executable ID
notes: Keep as an uncommon path feature; do not guess the EWMA parameter.

canonical_definition: raw beta = corr of five-year overlapping three-day returns times one-year stock volatility divided by one-year market volatility; score = -(0.6 * raw_beta + 0.4)
formation_refresh_holding: five-year correlation and one-year volatility; monthly refresh and holding
required_inputs: stock and market daily total returns|RF optional
pit_rule: minimum 750 valid days for correlation and all data known by signal close
long_only_evidence: paper strategy relies partly on leverage and shorting
project_translation: evaluate long-only low-beta without claiming to reproduce BAB
notes: May improve risk metrics without adding independent alpha.

canonical_definition: negative square root of residual variance from daily FF3 regression over the prior 21 sessions
formation_refresh_holding: 21 sessions; monthly refresh and holding
required_inputs: daily stock excess return|daily MKT SMB HML RF
pit_rule: regression uses only completed sessions and requires at least 15 valid observations
long_only_evidence: effect often stronger in short leg and small stocks
project_translation: a CAPM residual version requires a separate ID
notes: MAX and IVOL must share a family weight in later aggregation.

display_name: maximum daily return over one month
canonical_definition: -max(daily total return over prior 21 sessions)
formation_refresh_holding: 21 sessions; monthly refresh and holding
pit_rule: all 21 daily returns known at signal close
long_only_evidence: high-MAX underperformance partly comes from the short side
project_translation: retain MAX1 as primary; MAX5 would be a separate sensitivity ID
notes: Expected to correlate with IVOL skewness and retail attention.

canonical_definition: conditional covariance of stock and market excess returns when market excess return is below its mean divided by conditional market variance
high_score_means: greater exposure to downside market states
formation_refresh_holding: at least 252 daily observations; monthly refresh and holding
pit_rule: conditioning threshold and regression window estimated only from past data
long_only_evidence: long-only premium may be compensation for risk
project_translation: keep as a risk feature rather than an automatic low-risk preference
notes: Direction differs from low beta because the paper studies a priced downside exposure.

canonical_definition: negative fitted 12-month failure probability from the paper's dynamic logit using market return volatility size price cash profitability leverage and book-to-market inputs
formation_refresh_holding: monthly predictor update and holding
pit_rule: each input uses its publication timestamp and the frozen published coefficient vector
long_only_evidence: distressed stocks underperform but effect can be short-leg driven
project_translation: resolve exact published coefficients and winsorization before implementation
notes: A complex uncommon signal that combines market and balance-sheet information.

canonical_definition: mean over 252 sessions of abs(daily return) / (raw close * volume shares)
high_score_means: higher price impact and illiquidity premium
formation_refresh_holding: 252 sessions; monthly refresh; one-month project holding
pit_rule: volume units split treatment and provider identity must pass a new dataset gate
long_only_evidence: large-cap long leg may be weak
project_translation: do not compute from the current unqualified volume column
notes: High score may be economically unattractive for a concentrated executable portfolio.

canonical_definition: D1 = 1 - R2_restricted / R2_unrestricted where weekly stock returns are regressed on current market return only versus current plus four lags
formation_refresh_holding: 52 weekly observations; monthly refresh and holding
pit_rule: all regression weeks end before signal close; require at least 40 observations
long_only_evidence: large-stock effect may be attenuated
project_translation: retain D1 only; coefficient-weighted alternatives need new IDs
notes: Mechanistically distinct from Amihud despite expected correlation.

canonical_definition: percentile rank of current-day volume within the stock's current and prior 49 trading days
high_score_means: unusually high recent attention and activity
formation_refresh_holding: 50 sessions; refresh at signal schedule; paper holds one to twenty days
pit_rule: volume units and split handling fixed before rolling rank
long_only_evidence: paper reports a high-volume long premium
project_translation: monthly five-day aggregation would require a separate translation ID
notes: Current volume exists but is not yet qualified across Yahoo and Tiingo.

canonical_definition: double sort on prior six-month price momentum and prior six-month average turnover; favor winners with the paper-specified volume state
high_score_means: momentum whose continuation horizon is supported by volume state
formation_refresh_holding: six-month momentum and turnover; monthly refresh with medium holding
pit_rule: turnover denominator and all volume history available by signal close
long_only_evidence: paper evidence is conditional rather than pure-volume long leg
project_translation: do not treat raw volume as a standalone alpha proxy
notes: Turnover requires PIT shares; dollar volume is not a substitute.

canonical_definition: log(SVI_week) - log(median(SVI over prior eight weeks))
high_score_means: greater retail attention for the short one-to-two-week horizon
formation_refresh_holding: eight-week baseline; weekly refresh; one-to-two-week primary horizon
required_inputs: vintage Google Trends SVI|unambiguous query mapping
pit_rule: raw query batch scaling and retrieval vintage stored; ambiguous tickers excluded
long_only_evidence: short-horizon pressure is positive and later reverses
project_translation: long-horizon reversal must receive a separate ID and direction
notes: Google Trends resampling makes raw-download versioning essential.

canonical_definition: -log(1 + count of firm-specific media articles over prior 12 months)
formation_refresh_holding: 12 months; annual or monthly refresh; one-year paper horizon
pit_rule: articles enter after timestamp and entity link was knowable
long_only_evidence: effect is stronger in small and neglected stocks
project_translation: coverage count is distinct from text tone
notes: S&P 500 restriction may remove much of the original dispersion.

canonical_definition: - negative_word_count / total_word_count across firm-specific news released before the signal cutoff
formation_refresh_holding: event or short rolling window; refresh after news; one-to-ten-day horizon
pit_rule: publication timestamp precedes signal and dictionary version is frozen
long_only_evidence: negative language predicts short-run underreaction
project_translation: a FinBERT score would be a different model-generated factor
notes: The paper uses a fixed dictionary; a modern language model cannot inherit its evidence.

canonical_definition: - shares_short / PIT shares_outstanding
formation_refresh_holding: exchange reporting cycle; monthly refresh and holding
required_inputs: short-interest release|PIT shares outstanding|institutional ownership for interaction
pit_rule: usable only after the public release date rather than settlement date
long_only_evidence: negative effect can be concentrated in high-short names
project_translation: institutional-ownership interaction receives a separate composite ID if used
notes: Borrow fee is not available and must not be inferred from short interest.

canonical_definition: PIT common book equity / current PIT market equity
high_score_means: cheaper price relative to book equity
formation_refresh_holding: annual accounting formation; monthly price refresh; one-month project holding
pit_rule: book equity enters after filing; current market cap uses historical effective shares
long_only_evidence: classic evidence includes long leg but varies by era
project_translation: BM EP CFP and enterprise multiple are separate variants within one family
notes: Use consistent treatment of negative book equity.

canonical_definition: trailing PIT earnings available at signal time / current market equity
formation_refresh_holding: annual or trailing-quarter update; monthly refresh and holding
pit_rule: earnings enter after filing and revisions preserve vintage
long_only_evidence: value long-leg evidence exists
project_translation: retain as value-family alternative rather than independent theory
notes: Loss firms need a fixed missing or floor policy before execution.

canonical_definition: trailing PIT operating cash flow / current market equity
high_score_means: cheaper price relative to cash generation
formation_refresh_holding: annual or trailing-quarter update; monthly refresh and holding
pit_rule: cash flow enters only after filing and vintage is retained
long_only_evidence: value long-leg evidence exists
project_translation: cash-flow value may be less redundant with accrual quality than EP
notes: Cash-flow classification must be consistent across firms.

canonical_definition: - (market equity + debt + preferred stock - cash) / EBITDA
high_score_means: lower enterprise value per unit of EBITDA
formation_refresh_holding: annual accounting update; monthly market-value refresh and holding
pit_rule: all capital-structure and EBITDA inputs enter after filing
long_only_evidence: paper reports a strong low-multiple long side
project_translation: exclude financial firms and nonpositive EBITDA under a frozen rule
notes: More capital-structure-aware than BM EP or CFP.

canonical_definition: (common dividends + share repurchases - common share issuances) / year-end market equity
high_score_means: greater net cash distribution to shareholders
formation_refresh_holding: annual accounting formation; monthly holding
pit_rule: cash flows available after filing; no future issuance information
long_only_evidence: paper reports cross-sectional information beyond dividend yield
project_translation: cash-flow-based measure is primary
notes: Shares-based issuance proxy is a distinct alternative.

canonical_definition: three-stage residual-income value using PIT analyst forecasts divided by current market price
high_score_means: higher forecast-based intrinsic value relative to price
formation_refresh_holding: forecast update; monthly refresh; medium holding
required_inputs: PIT analyst forecasts|PIT book value|cost-of-equity inputs|price
pit_rule: only forecasts released before cutoff and original forecast vintages may enter
long_only_evidence: original paper reports positive value-to-price spread
project_translation: resolve exact terminal growth and discount-rate rules from paper code before execution
notes: A deliberately uncommon valuation model rather than another simple multiple.

canonical_definition: (revenue - cost of goods sold) / total assets
formation_refresh_holding: annual accounting update; monthly holding
pit_rule: fiscal record enters after filing and retains vintage
long_only_evidence: large-liquid stock evidence is explicitly reported
project_translation: primary simple profitability representative
notes: Expected to correlate with OP and cash profitability but not perfectly.

canonical_definition: (revenue - COGS - SG&A - interest expense) / book equity under the Fama-French definition
formation_refresh_holding: annual June formation; monthly project holding
pit_rule: accounting data follows conservative filing availability
long_only_evidence: factor evidence includes robust-profitability long leg
project_translation: use as an alternative to GP rather than another independent family
notes: Exact Fama-French variable inclusion must be copied from the official definition.

canonical_definition: cash component of operating profitability divided by total assets using the paper's operating-accrual decomposition
formation_refresh_holding: annual accounting update; monthly holding
pit_rule: all components enter after filing with vintage preserved
long_only_evidence: paper finds stronger prediction than accrual-inclusive profitability
project_translation: retain despite correlation with GP because it isolates accrual quality
notes: Exact cash operating-profit formula must be transcribed into the later executable spec.

canonical_definition: cross-sectional average of standardized profitability growth safety and payout component scores as defined in the paper
formation_refresh_holding: monthly score from latest PIT inputs; one-month holding
pit_rule: each component observes its own filing or market availability and all standardization is same-date cross-sectional
long_only_evidence: quality long leg is directly studied
project_translation: component scores remain separately visible; QMJ is not counted as four new ideas
notes: Composite complexity is intentional and should be compared with simple GP.

canonical_definition: sum of nine binary tests for profitability cash flow change in ROA accrual quality leverage liquidity issuance margin and turnover efficiency
high_score_means: stronger fundamental health among value stocks
formation_refresh_holding: annual formation after filing; original one to two-year diagnostics
pit_rule: all current and lagged statements available after filing; value-universe filter is PIT
long_only_evidence: original evidence is explicitly within high-BM stocks
project_translation: do not use as an unconditional full-universe score without a new ID
notes: A useful nonlinear rule-based benchmark for later ML.

canonical_definition: perpetual-inventory stock of SG&A using the paper's industry depreciation rate divided by total assets
formation_refresh_holding: annual update after filing; monthly holding
pit_rule: all vintages and industry mapping available by filing date
long_only_evidence: paper reports higher returns for high organization capital
project_translation: resolve initialization depreciation and industry treatment before execution
notes: Uncommon mechanism relevant to human-capital-intensive firms.

canonical_definition: PIT patent count or citation output divided by lagged R&D expenditure using the paper's citation adjustments
high_score_means: more innovation output per unit of R&D input
formation_refresh_holding: annual patent vintage update; long holding
required_inputs: PIT patent grants and citations|PIT R&D|firm mapping
pit_rule: patent and citation information enter only when public; citation truncation correction is vintage-aware
long_only_evidence: paper reports positive long-side relation
project_translation: patent count and citation efficiency must be separate future IDs if both run
notes: A genuinely non-price and uncommon signal.

canonical_definition: -[(change current assets - change cash) - (change current liabilities - change short debt - change taxes payable)] / average total assets
formation_refresh_holding: annual update after filing; one-year original holding
pit_rule: both current and lagged filings available with original vintage
long_only_evidence: paper spread may include a strong short leg
project_translation: cash-flow-statement accruals would need a separate ID
notes: Correlated with cash profitability and NOA but represents a flow rather than a stock.

canonical_definition: -[(operating assets - operating liabilities) / beginning total assets] under the paper's balance-sheet classification
formation_refresh_holding: annual update after filing; long-horizon diagnostics
pit_rule: current and beginning assets available after filings with vintage preserved
long_only_evidence: paper reports strong negative predictor
project_translation: retain separately from annual accrual flow
notes: NOA is accumulated earnings not backed by free cash flow.

canonical_definition: -(total_assets[t] - total_assets[t-1]) / total_assets[t-1]
formation_refresh_holding: annual update after filing; one-year holding
pit_rule: both annual statements available after their filing dates
long_only_evidence: effect retained in large-cap stocks
project_translation: primary investment-family representative
notes: Expected to correlate with capex NOA and issuance.

canonical_definition: negative current capital expenditure divided by its trailing three-year average minus one under the paper's definition
formation_refresh_holding: annual update after filing; multi-year original diagnostics
pit_rule: current and three prior annual filings available
long_only_evidence: negative future return relation is documented
project_translation: exact averaging denominator must be frozen from the paper before execution
notes: More targeted than total asset growth but more missing-data-sensitive.

canonical_definition: - growth in split-adjusted shares outstanding over the prior 12 months
high_score_means: lower dilution or greater repurchase activity
formation_refresh_holding: 12 months; monthly or annual refresh and one-year holding
pit_rule: shares and split factors use historical effective dates
long_only_evidence: negative issuance-return relation documented
project_translation: do not infer shares from volume
notes: Expected to correlate with asset growth but reflects financing choice.

canonical_definition: negative five-year change in market equity not explained by cumulative stock return under the Daniel-Titman decomposition
formation_refresh_holding: five-year decomposition; annual or monthly refresh
pit_rule: market cap and all return endpoints historically available
long_only_evidence: issuance component has predictive evidence
project_translation: highly related to net share issuance and should share a family weight
notes: More robust to issuance mechanisms but depends on a long history.

canonical_definition: negative residual from decomposing five-year stock return into the return implied by book-value growth and financing versus unexplained intangible return
high_score_means: less price appreciation unsupported by tangible information
formation_refresh_holding: five-year decomposition; periodic refresh and subsequent holding
pit_rule: all accounting and financing information respects historical availability
long_only_evidence: paper finds future reversal tied to intangible return
project_translation: resolve decomposition equations exactly before execution
notes: An uncommon residualized bridge between valuation and behavioral overreaction.

canonical_definition: (quarterly EPS[t] - EPS[t-4]) divided by the trailing standard deviation of seasonal EPS changes
formation_refresh_holding: quarterly event update; hold after announcement through next rebalance or fixed drift window
pit_rule: EPS becomes available at actual release time; denominator uses only earlier released quarters
long_only_evidence: positive-surprise long drift is documented
project_translation: analyst-based surprise is a separate future ID
notes: Never align the signal to fiscal quarter end.

canonical_definition: percentage change in PIT consensus FY1 EPS over the prior month with a fixed denominator treatment
formation_refresh_holding: one month; monthly refresh and holding
pit_rule: only estimates timestamped before each month-end enter the historical consensus
long_only_evidence: paper reports long-only forecast-revision performance
project_translation: three-month revision would require a separate ID
notes: Vendor backfills and estimate deletions must retain original vintages.

canonical_definition: change in PIT consensus target price over the prior month divided by prior consensus target or stock price under a frozen rule
formation_refresh_holding: one month; monthly refresh and holding
pit_rule: only released target prices enter and stale observations have a fixed maximum age
long_only_evidence: future long-only evidence is weaker than EPS revision alone
project_translation: denominator choice must be resolved before executable registration
notes: Potentially useful jointly with earnings and recommendation revisions.

canonical_definition: - standard deviation of current analyst EPS forecasts divided by absolute consensus mean with a frozen small-denominator rule
formation_refresh_holding: current consensus; monthly refresh and holding
pit_rule: only active forecasts issued before cutoff; one forecast is missing rather than zero dispersion
long_only_evidence: high-dispersion underperformance is often short-leg driven
project_translation: keep separate from revision direction
notes: Small denominator handling materially changes ranks.

canonical_definition: change in number or fraction of eligible institutions holding the stock from prior quarter
formation_refresh_holding: quarterly 13F formation; original twelve-month diagnostics
pit_rule: 13F data available no earlier than filing release and normally after the statutory 45-day delay
long_only_evidence: top breadth-change portfolio outperforms bottom
project_translation: ownership fraction change is a distinct alternative to breadth change
notes: Must control mergers of reporting managers and coverage-universe changes.

canonical_definition: - buyer-initiated opening put volume / buyer-initiated opening call volume for matched short-dated liquid options
high_score_means: more bullish informed option order flow
formation_refresh_holding: daily formation; one-day to one-week holding
pit_rule: trade classification and option data available before stock signal cutoff
long_only_evidence: low put-call ratio long side is directly documented
project_translation: ordinary total put-call volume is not the paper signal
notes: Requires proprietary opening-buyer classification.

canonical_definition: -(implied volatility of 30-day 0.8-moneyness OTM put - implied volatility of matched ATM call)
formation_refresh_holding: weekly formation; one to six-month diagnostics
pit_rule: quotes and curve inputs known by cutoff; interpolation uses only current surface
long_only_evidence: least-pronounced-smirk long side outperforms
project_translation: maturity and moneyness interpolation must follow the paper
notes: Direction is explicitly reversed so higher score is preferred.

canonical_definition: ATM implied volatility for about 30 days minus realized volatility over the prior 30 days
formation_refresh_holding: monthly formation and holding
pit_rule: option surface known by cutoff and realized window entirely historical
long_only_evidence: paper documents negative relation for realized-minus-implied spread
project_translation: store original RIVolSpread sign in metadata
notes: Potential volatility-risk premium proxy rather than pure direction forecast.

canonical_definition: matched call implied volatility minus matched put implied volatility
formation_refresh_holding: monthly formation and holding
pit_rule: same-date contracts matched on maturity and moneyness before cutoff
long_only_evidence: positive expected-return relation is documented
project_translation: do not collapse with IV smirk or put-call flow
notes: Carries directional option information distinct from IV-RV.

canonical_definition: sales-share-weighted prior-month return of the firm's principal customers disclosed as at least 10 percent of sales
high_score_means: stronger recent performance among economically linked customers
formation_refresh_holding: one month; monthly refresh and one-month holding
required_inputs: PIT customer-supplier graph|sales shares|customer returns|entity mapping
pit_rule: relationship enters only after the relevant filing and expires under a frozen staleness rule
long_only_evidence: both legs contribute but asymmetry is reported
project_translation: control for own momentum and industry momentum in later diagnostics
notes: A distinct information network rather than another own-price momentum window.

canonical_definition: -[(change current assets - change cash) - (change current liabilities - change short debt - change taxes payable) - depreciation and amortization] / average total assets
high_score_means: lower balance-sheet accrual component of earnings
formation_refresh_holding: annual update after filing; one-year original holding
required_inputs: PIT current assets|cash|current liabilities|short-term debt|taxes payable|depreciation and amortization|current and lagged total assets|PIT filing history
pit_rule: all components use the same filing accession period and duration where applicable; current and lagged annual vintages must be available by the signal cutoff; amendments affect only later signals
long_only_evidence: paper spread may include a strong short leg
project_translation: corrected executable successor to XS039_ACCRUALS; the historical row remains unchanged and non-executable
notes: Includes the depreciation term omitted from the historical registry row. No component may be filled with zero.

canonical_definition: -(net income - cash flow from operations) / average total assets
formation_refresh_holding: annual update after filing; one-year project holding
required_inputs: PIT net income|PIT cash flow from operations|current and lagged total assets|PIT filing history
pit_rule: net income and CFO use the same filing accession period and annual duration; both asset vintages must be available by the signal cutoff; amendments affect only later signals
long_only_evidence: project translation requires independent long-only validation
project_translation: separate coverage-oriented cash-flow path; never a silent fallback for XS039_ACCRUALS_V2
notes: This project definition does not inherit the strict Sloan replication claim or its evidence. Missing net income or CFO remains missing rather than zero.
